contains.1.8.71: Calendar-first and data-repo fixes. The data repo is created private by itself once GitHub access works (no create button, never from a half-typed repo name, never overwritten) and every failure says what GitHub reports while local saving continues. Items with no date open their edit page with the date picker so they can be dated; Change applies to this occurrence or this and future without rewriting earlier ones; Record what happened is saved to the occurrence (this occurrence only unless chosen otherwise, with the item and its planned amount shown); a day row shows that day's recorded or changed amount; Specific dates each month repeats on those days, and the days box shows what will be saved (the date's day until changed); day rows say how an item repeats in words; a tap on Save or a row while a field is still open now lands on the first tap; tapping a calendar entry opens that item's own page (name, day, time, repeat, amount) instead of the sample item; the date and tab refresh keeps the tapped entry and a form's draft; real schedules no longer say their values are sample data; an amount entered on the calendar is the cost each time (not split across the month's dates); pay on the calendar is the take-home. Old Board asset, debt and pay entries open the selected calendar day; Budget has no what-if path; cash is never inferred from a name.
contains.1.8.70: Home has one way to open a day's schedule (second tap on the selected mini-month day). Activity date pickers expand inline; Repeat subrows reflow; times are 24-hour; Amount has one label. Plan lives only on Home, with wrapped step text and a back stack to the step. New alternatives and new requirements share date/time/repeat fields.
contains.1.8.69: Day and Plan entry; form overlays sit on the drawn box, including a Safari width correction; date, time, and debt as-of are real pickers; Repeat, deductions, and debt fields persist onto the agenda calendar; all-day pay, debt, and cash rows appear on the day schedule; Save debt opens the as-of day.
contains.app: 1.8.68: Budget journal back controls use a drawn chevron plus Home/Plan text (the platform bar no longer uses a Unicode arrow that became tofu); long row names and selected items never overlap (two-line or ellipsis); Add to <day> is visible on the selected calendar day and opens the four-kind chooser; a Plan row opens the alternatives list with + Add an alternative, then category, preferred star, requirements review, and Plan switch Before/After Accept; monthly expenses lists Income/Expenses dated through today and Scheduled this month without a 40-row cap, with the month total after the last row and a scrollable sticky-canvas page; Cash and owned item rows open the as-of calendar day and no longer share a full-page Home hit; CSS pt equals design pt (host size from CSS, not device pixels).
contains.chromeJr: PlatformChromeJR: JRDI circular avatar photo (exclusive initials fallback); bar/apps JRViews; Budget tabs in hostDoc
